title: A Machine Learning Approach for Real-Time Detection of Inadequate Sedation Using Non-EEG Physiological Signals.
summary: LightGBM on non-EEG physiologic signals classified BIS-defined inadequate sedation in retrospective VitalDB data. It supports a signal-prediction result; real-time clinical effectiveness was not established.
